name: linkedin
title: LinkedIn cut
summary: A square or 4:5 film for the LinkedIn feed, 15 to 90 seconds, built to be read with the sound off.
use_when: A professional audience in a feed: a cut-down of a brand film or explainer, or a short standalone point.

4:5.note: Takes more of the feed than square; LinkedIn's largest 4:5 size.

beats.name: point
beats.job: The claim or question, in words on screen within three seconds.

beats.name: insight
beats.job: The one idea, with its proof.

beats.name: call to action
beats.job: What to do next and where.

rules: Designed for sound off: burned-in captions and supers carry every word.
Lead with the point; a sourced number reads faster than an adjective.

budget.note: Generation only when it's allowed and adds something.

notes: LinkedIn recommends 30 fps. A cut derived from a 29.97 film keeps its parent's clock, which LinkedIn accepts.
